build_baselinemodel: build a BaselineModel with a processor factory, hidden dim, and learning rate for CLRS graph algorithm training
build_baselinemodelchunked: build a BaselineModelChunked instance for training on fixed-timelength chunks of graph algorithm data
test_baseline_predict: test the BaselineModel predict method to run inference on graph features and get output predictions
test_baseline_feedback: test the BaselineModel feedback method to compute gradients and update model parameters in one step
test_filter_null_grads: test the filter_null_grads function to compute optimizer updates while ignoring parameters with zero gradients
